chunk. The block below is shown as an example only — see the cheat sheet in
this project for how to turn on live code:

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Engine displacement", y = "Highway MPG")
```
